title: sensitive file access pattern
message: Skill content reads or references sensitive files such as .env, credentials, private keys, or ~/.ssh; a human should confirm the access is intentional and scoped before trusting this skill.

title: remote shell execution pattern
message: Skill content pipes remote downloads straight into a shell (for example curl | sh) or fetches remote executable scripts; this executes unreviewed code and should be replaced by verified, pinned installs.

title: dangerous destructive shell pattern
message: Skill content contains destructive or privilege-escalating shell patterns such as rm -rf or sudo; a human should confirm the targets are intentional and safely scoped.
